lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Four hours up the valley road. The monastery is a low building with a light on, which at this hour in this century is close to a miracle.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A woman in a habit is standing in the doorway as though she has been expecting somebody for some time and is not fussy about who.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You walked up. Nobody walks up. Come inside before you are a silhouette on a road.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Only that you are the sort of trouble that arrives on foot at four in the morning. Come in. There is a man inside who is going to be extremely rude to you, and he is worth listening to anyway.
